decisions.reason: After several years on the market, this multi-model dental consumable still fits the firm's core laboratory materials range and is unlikely to be withdrawn unless the portfolio is simplified.
The PETG thermoforming blank remains close to the firm's established dental materials business, and surviving beyond launch suggests a stable role in the portfolio.
